I genuinely do think this course needs a rework from the ground up. While I do think that the intend of encouraging students to creatively write in Turkish is important, the fact that instructors being subjective in how they grade students is extremely unprofessional. For example, a student may write a blog that one instructor likes very much and is highly graded, while that same blog read by a different instructor might be very poorly graded. This disconnect between what a “good written blog” can be regarded as is the main reason why I extremely dislike the current function of this course.
